    As of 2026, Pam Bondi is in a long-term relationship with
    John Wakefield, a private equity founder and businessman with whom she has been partnered since 2017. While sometimes referred to as her husband by acquaintances, it is unconfirmed if they are officially married. She was previously married to Garret Barnes and Scott Fitzgerald. 
    Key Details About John Wakefield 
    • Relationship Status: Frequently referred to as her partner or boyfriend since 2017. He was called her "handsome husband" by Donald Trump during a February 2025 swearing-in ceremony, though this has not been independently confirmed as a marriage.
    • Background: Wakefield is a businessman who founded Varner Wakefield Equity Partners.
    • Career: He has worked as an executive vice president at Ellison Development and as a banker, according to his LinkedIn profile.
    • Family: He is described as the father of three children. 
    Pam Bondi's Marital History 
    • Garret Barnes: Married 1990, divorced 1992.
    • Scott Fitzgerald: Married 1996, divorced 2002.
    • Greg Henderson: Engaged/informal ceremony in 2012, later split.
